original.statement: A read-only `status` field (with `status.bindings[]` and their conditions) was added to the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 PodMonitor schema. It is only updated when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled.

decision.reason: [ev-5415b8753dfa] shows the `status` property being added to the v1 schema of the PodMonitor CRD (podmonitors.monitoring.coreos.com) between 0.85.0 and 0.86.2. The new schema applies to every PodMonitor v1 object, whether or not the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is on. The gate only controls whether the operator fills the field in. So environments that use monitoring.coreos.com/v1 PodMonitor are exactly the ones this change touches, and no narrower or broader condition is supported. This matches the consensus fact vf-27c6379f9739, and the consequence of none is fixed context.
